_how_this_works: src/poster.py re-reads this file on every run. Edit wording here. Never type a result number here.
{name} placeholders are filled from data/public/results.json, yearly_changes.csv and validation_summary.json at run time.
See every placeholder and its current value: .venv/bin/python src/poster.py --list-placeholders
A placeholder whose data is missing prints as 'not available' and is listed on stdout. A name that does not exist stays in braces and src/poster_check.py fails.
**word** makes bold text. Body text must stay at 60 words or fewer per card. The check counts them.
For the chart cards (C1 to D1) this file holds the wording of each possible title. The rule that picks which form is used is in src/poster.py and follows the pre-registered decision rules.

Inside the chart-card forms, extra names work: {source}, {Source}, {est}, {ci_low}, {ci_high}, {p_text}, {n_pairs}, {strength}, {worse}, {better}, {diff}, {diff_low}, {diff_high}, {rank_list}, {rank_list_of}, {n_top}, {n_cities}, {Other} and the {other_...} values.

fallbacks._note: Plan values from spec/methodology.md. Used only when the results file has no value yet, and reported on stdout when used.

banner.title: Measuring What Matters
banner.question: When a city's problems get worse, does public attention follow?
banner.name: Cayden Auyang

A4_repo.heading: Check the data and code
A4_repo.ai_use: AI use: an AI language model labeled the articles, a second AI model from a different family checked the labels, and AI tools ran the analysis and drafted the text.

B1_question.heading: The question
body: Cities publish official statistics on problems like crime and housing.
News coverage and Google searches show what the public pays attention to.
When a problem gets worse in the official numbers, does attention rise with it?

B2_why.heading: Why it matters
body: Official data and public attention are both imperfect measures of the same problems.
Recorded crime counts only what gets reported.
Attention can follow a news cycle and miss slow change.
When the two disagree, either one can be wrong.

B3_method.heading: Three voices, one comparison
B3_method.comparison: Compare yearly changes: do they move together?

D3_limits.heading: Limits and changes to the plan
body: AI labeled the articles. A second AI from a different model family checked a sample. No human coded any article.
The whole study ran in one night.
Search data rests on {search_downloads} per request. The plan said three.
Hong Kong news before 2020 rests on one outlet.

D4_next.heading: What comes next
body: Then a submission to the Journal of Emerging Investigators.
The dataset and code are public, so anyone can check the numbers.
